name: Vespid Colony
comment: The space_buzzer_hive look: spawns a Vespid (387622 "alien buzzer hive spawn castable", SpawnMonster VOOL) beside itself every 2.5 s while players are within 12.5 m, up to 5 alive (the cap a guess). The user (2026-10-30): the hive spawns Space Buzzers like the mounds. Its name is TDB 51000 #1453 "Vespid Colony" (among the Space Port templates; live called the space_buzzer look Vespid); level and stats as the Small Spider Mound's. Nothing places it: neither the live capture nor the client's data has one.
